summary: Liquidity and balance-sheet analytics professional with ~7 years of institutional client-facing and advisory experience, aligned to the Transaction Banking - VP, Trade Finance, Cash Management and Liquidity Solutions mandate at BNP Paribas. Designed a multi-scenario cash flow projection engine and time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics at Moody's Analytics; led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian institutional clients; delivered multi-currency hedging, funding, and asset allocation studies at Ortec Finance across Canadian and international mandates. CFA charterholder; dual MSc, Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering.
core_skills: Liquidity Gap & Funding Analysis (T+1 to Multi-Year)
Balance-Sheet & Accounting Analysis (CFA Foundation; IFRS 9/17 Transformation Delivery)

sections.heading: Liquidity Solutions & Cash Flow Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across institutional balance-sheet horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset allocation decisions for client portfolios.
Embedded behavioural cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations and executive contingency planning.

sections.heading: Client Portfolio Reviews & Senior Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and balance-sheet outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional clients, $5-25bn per engagement and ~$50bn+ cumulatively across the book of work.
Serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders to resolve them under delivery deadlines.

Prepare periodic analytical reviews for senior stakeholders covering interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Multi-Currency Derivatives Validation & Operational Controls
bullets: Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Contribute to the model governance framework as a committee member, reviewing methodology, documentation and benchmarking standards, and escalating outputs lacking economic defensibility.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

sections.heading: Client Onboarding, Implementation & Requirements Translation
bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping complex client requirements into structured development requests and advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform, validating model outputs post-deployment.

Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning accounting and regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.

Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral, and coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.

Delivered ALM and balance-sheet studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet and liquidity risk exposures.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Advised clients on Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis, including liability-driven investment work balancing return, duration, and liquidity objectives.
Presented study findings on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients, converting technical results into decisions the committee could act on.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
